judge_fix.symptom: World log repeated 'The judge did not answer for X and Y'; POST /api/encounter returned judge failed.
judge_fix.root_cause: wrangler tail zoo-core: AiError 5021, estimated input plus output tokens (69429) exceeded the Clef context window (65536). Merged child code and descriptions grow every generation and were sent whole.
judge_fix.fix: compactFighter in src/worker/ai.ts caps description, code, and memory before the Clef call. parseVerdict is tested against a real Clef response body.

names: childName in src/worker/behavior.ts mixes both parents, selfing adds a seeded ending, and World.uniqueName adds a number on collision. Starters are only topped up by names not already alive.
sprites: Sprites are cropped to their opaque bounding box and drawn at 72 to 92 world units, about 64 to 82 css px at the default zoom on a 720 px canvas.

egg.transport: existing world WebSocket, message type egg; snapshots include live eggs so other visitors see them
